summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 across the shared transit network, and routed the private lan-a (10.10.1.0/24, node3) and lan-b (10.10.2.0/24, node4) networks over it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by their private addresses, with all inter-site traffic encrypted (verified via tcpdump: only UDP/51820 WireGuard packets are visible on the transit link, never plaintext ICMP). Topology was discovered via STP bridge-id fingerprinting on the previously-down eth1/eth2 NICs (node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 = transit; node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 = lan-a; node2 eth2<->node4 eth1 = lan-b). Configured via OpenWrt UCI (network/firewall) on node1/node2 and persistent /etc/network/interfaces static+route stanzas on Alpine node3/node4. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state, triggered native reboot with a returning acknowledgement, polled until each node's exec access returned, proved boot_id changed each time, and verified full recovery (interfaces up, WireGuard handshake re-established automatically, private-address ping between node3/node4 working, encryption re-confirmed via tcpdump) before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected topology and found only mgmt NICs (eth0/br-lan) up; eth1/eth2 on node1/node2 and eth1 on node3/node4 were down
Identified physical segment pairing via STP bridge-id fingerprints seen through tcpdump (installed tcpdump via apk on all 4 nodes)
Configured OpenWrt UCI network interfaces 'transit' (10.10.0.0/30) and 'lana'/'lanb' (10.10.1.0/24, 10.10.2.0/24) on node1/node2, committed and reloaded
Added OpenWrt firewall zones (transit, lana/lanb, vpn) and forwarding rules (lana<->vpn, lanb<->vpn) without touching the mgmt lan/wan zones

Generated WireGuard keypairs on node1/node2 (private keys passed via secret_env, never in command args or final report) and configured UCI wireguard proto interface 'vpn' with peer allowed_ips covering the opposite private subnet plus tunnel /32
Full network restart on node1/node2 to bring up the new wireguard interface (reload alone was insufficient); verified handshake and route installation

Assigned static IPs to node3 eth1 (10.10.1.2/24) and node4 eth1 (10.10.2.2/24) with a static route to the remote private subnet via the local router, persisted in /etc/network/interfaces (auto eth1 + post-up route)
Verified node3<->node4 reachability by private address and confirmed via tcpdump that only encrypted UDP/51820 WireGuard traffic crosses the transit link (no plaintext ICMP)
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime/wg-show/ip-addr baseline on all 4 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time using backgrounded `reboot` so the ack returned before disconnection; polled each until exec access returned
Confirmed changed boot_id and reset uptime on every node post-restart

Verified post-restart recovery: interfaces/routes auto-restored, WireGuard tunnel auto-reestablished with fresh handshake on node1/node2, node3<->node4 private-address ping success after each restart, re-verified encryption-only transit traffic after all 4 restarts completed

evidence.requirement: Topology discovery: mapping node1/node2 eth1/eth2 and node3/node4 eth1 to transit/lan-a/lan-b segments
evidence.summary: STP bridge-id fingerprints captured via tcpdump on each interface confirm node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 (transit), node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 (lan-a), node2 eth2<->node4 eth1 (lan-b)

evidence.requirement: Transit and private network IP configuration applied and working
evidence.summary: Static addressing on transit (10.10.0.0/30) and lan-a/lan-b applied via UCI/ip commands; node1<->node2 transit ping succeeds

evidence.requirement: Encrypted WireGuard tunnel established between node1 and node2
evidence.summary: wg show on both routers shows active peer, handshake completed, and traffic counters incrementing over the vpn interface

evidence.requirement: node3 and node4 reach each other by private address, and that traffic is encrypted in transit
evidence.summary: node3 pings node4's private IP (10.10.2.2) successfully while a concurrent tcpdump on node1's transit interface shows only encrypted UDP/51820 WireGuard packets, never plaintext ICMP

evidence.requirement: Persistence of node3/node4 private network config across reboot
evidence.summary: Static IP and route added to /etc/network/interfaces; validated via ifdown/ifup cycle that config reapplies correctly

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1db33cf1...; reboot acked; connection timeout confirms in-progress reboot; new boot_id 7f53e988... with uptime 0; interfaces/vpn/wg handshake auto-recovered; node3->node4 ping succeeds post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 15b8cb6c...; reboot acked; connection timeout confirms reboot; new boot_id 13426250... with uptime 0; interfaces/vpn/wg handshake auto-recovered; node4->node3 ping succeeds post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7d9bc801...; reboot acked; connection reset confirms reboot; new boot_id 21d4825d... with uptime 0; eth1 static IP and private route auto-restored from /etc/network/interfaces; ping to node4 private IP succeeds

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 92303207...; reboot acked; connection reset confirms reboot; new boot_id c0abe4c8... with uptime 0; eth1 static IP and private route auto-restored; ping to node3 private IP succeeds

evidence.requirement: Final post-all-restarts confirmation that tunnel encryption and end-to-end routing remain correct
evidence.summary: After all four restarts, node3<->node4 private-address pings succeed and a final tcpdump on node2's transit interface during a node4->node3 ping shows only encrypted WireGuard UDP/51820 traffic
